subject: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@clockwork.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection

Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, the internal evaluation window is shifting on your side (QA resource availability) and we expect the originally targeted go‑live (11/12) is not achievable without adjusting scope or adding parallel validation lanes. I captured a few options in an updated MAP draft attached (RW-MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short SOW revision for clarity.

Can you confirm which of these constraints is the binding one on your end:
- QA bandwidth (single-threaded validation)
- Procurement timing for the license amendment
- Data readiness for the staging import

If QA is the blocker we recommend a staggered acceptance: sandbox + core APIs first, then full production import — that buys ~3–4 weeks with minimal risk. If procurement is the blocker we can offer a short, conditional access token to let engineering smoke test before licenses are finalized (requires approval from finance).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the primary blocker by EOD Wednesday (10/07).
2) We finalize the MAP (v3) and SOW revisions and circulate to procurement.
3) If needed, we schedule a 30min finance alignment with Ben to discuss short‑term token access.

Attached: RW-MAP_v3.xlsx (map with phased acceptance), Clockwork_SOW_revision_2026-10-05.pdf

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0123

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@clockwork.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clockwork.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection

Jordan —

Thanks for the update and the materials. The primary constraint right now is QA bandwidth — our lead QA has been pulled to a regulatory audit and we don’t expect full availability until ~10/29. Procurement is queued but not blocking the smoke tests; data readiness is on track for the staging slice.

A phased acceptance (sandbox/core APIs first) would work for us, provided we get a short token to validate performance against our dataset. Procurement would need a statement-of-work update to sign, but they are prepared to move quickly once the MAP is final.

I’ll confirm internal QA availability tomorrow, but please proceed with the MAP/SOW revision and copy procurement.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Singh
Product Manager, Clockwork.ai
aisha.singh@clockwork.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection

Jordan / team —

We should prepare two paths:
A) Procurement on normal cadence — finalize SOW and get signatures (target 10/20) and then staggered acceptance (go‑live window 11/02–11/12).
B) Procurement slower / QA delayed — offer a 30‑day conditional engineering token for smoke testing (no production data). This requires an approval note from legal + a short amendment. I can take point on risk acceptance and write the token guardrails.

Also want to quantify the risk impact to our delivery SLA: if they cannot stagger and push to a single consolidated validation after 10/29, our expected shipped acceptance stretches to 11/19 (risk of one additional iteration). I'll draft a short risk sheet.

Attaching: Procurement_Request_Form.pdf (template we send to procurement teams).

—Ben
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@clockwork.ai>, procurement@clockwork.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection

Aisha / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick signal. I’ve attached the updated MAP (v3) and a tracked SOW revision that explicitly calls out the phased acceptance gates and the conditional token flow. Key notes (summary):
- Phase 1 (Sandbox + Core API smoke): target 10/25–11/05 — verification by Clockwork QA using provided token.
- Phase 2 (Staging import + full validation): target 11/08–11/19 — procurement signoff required before staging import.
- Fallback: If QA still unavailable after 10/29, we push Phase 2 window to 11/22–12/03 and trigger exec sync for timeline acceptance.

Ben will join the Friday finance sync if procurement needs the conditional token and legal signoff. If we get a firm QA unblock date by EOD Thursday, we’ll keep the earlier path.

Please confirm procurement owner and the best time for the finance call (Ben proposed Fri 10/09 11:00 PT).

Jordan

From: procurement@clockwork.ai <procurement@clockwork.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@clockwork.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clockwork — MAP reprofiling & runway reprojection

Jordan / Ben —

Procurement reviewed the tracked SOW. We can expedite signature on the staged SOW but need two items completed before we issue the token:
1) A short insurance / data handling addendum (we have a template) — legal review needed.
2) Finance approval for an interim token arrangement (Procurement can sign once finance confirms there is no billing exposure beyond the standard MSA).

We’ve tentatively approved the 11/08–11/19 staging window on the condition the addendum and finance note are in place. If those items aren’t ready by 10/15 we will default to standard procurement timelines (which pushes go‑live to mid‑December).

Requesting Redwood leadership to confirm who will own the legal addendum turnaround and whether finance can commit to a conditional token approval meeting time (Ben: please propose).

Thanks,
Clockwork Procurement Team
procurement@clockwork.ai
